description:
Deterministic forensic-accounting scores for a single ticker: partial Beneish M-Score, Sloan accruals, and a solvency snapshot. Returns a red-flag narrative ranked by severity, with citations to source filings. Used by the `forensic_earnings_brief` SOP.

Note: full Beneish needs AR / current assets / PPE / SGA / current liabilities, which aren't in our fundamentals model. We compute the recoverable subset (SGI + TATA + LVGI) and flag `partial=true`. Plan: Benchmark and above.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company to audit, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B.

name: forensic_audit

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

metrics_display.description: Each figure in `result` rendered for prose, keyed by its path ('sloan_accruals', 'solvency.roa', 'm_score_components.sgi'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM instead of the raw numbers.

title: Forensic Audit (Beneish + Sloan + Solvency)
